doc.title: Monthly Updates [Feb]
doc.html:
INFO These update threads only contain major updates. If you're interested in seeing all minor changes you can follow our Commits Page on GitHub or Updates Channel in Discord.

Wiki Updates

  • Added Concerts / Live Shows section to Audio.

  • Added Genre Specific section to Audio Downloading.

  • Added Drinks section under Food.

  • Moved Collaboration Platforms out of storage, cleaned up the section, and added labels.

  • For individual notes, we've stopped linking to pastebins and instead link to our own GitHub page.

  • Added a Site Grading System for streaming to help sort them more fairly. This is currently a work in progress, and more categories will be added to further separate sites at the top, such as mobile optimization, ad-free streaming, watch list syncing, and more.

Stars Added ⭐

  • Starred DeepSeek in Online Chatbots. V3 is unlimited, and people seem to be really liking it so far.

  • Starred AnimeZ in Anime Streaming. Has fast streams and did well in our polls.

  • Starred OOMoye + PKMovies under Video Download. Both have big libraries, fast hosts, and single-click downloads.

  • Starred Ludusavi in Game Saves. Feature-rich game save manager that supports all platforms.

  • Starred TV Garden in Live TV. Nice UI, lots of channels, and consistent compared to similar options.

  • Starred PipePipe in Android YouTube Apps. Feature-rich fork of NewPipe w/ SponsorBlock / ReturnYTDislikes.

  • Starred PokéRogue in Pokémon section. Popular and fun Pokémon dungeon crawler.

  • Starred WatchParty in Stream Sync. Feature-rich video sync app that seems to work well for people.

  • Starred Gifski + EZGif under GIF Tools. High-quality GIF creation tools.

  • Starred Blatant's IPA Library in iOS Apps. High-quality iOS app releases; stands out compared to similar TG groups.

  • Starred Reaper under Audio Editors. Feature-rich digital audio workstation. It says it's a trial, but the trial never actually ends.

  • Added star back to SteamGG in Game DDL. Game download site with pre-installs and good hosts, similar to SteamRIP.

Things Removed

  • Unstarred Firehawk52 as Deezer ARLs are being nuked instantly now.

  • Unstarred IPALibrary and replaced it with CodeVN, as this is where IPALibrary sources its apps.
